name: Beazley
desc: London-based specialty insurer and Lloyd's underwriter covering cyber, property, marine, political risk and other specialist lines.
capacity_detail: Zurich's agreed GBP 8.1bn takeover was court-approved on 22 Sept 2026; Beazley was LSE-listed until acquired in September 2026; revenue USD 6.06bn in 2025
markets: Commercial clients and brokers in the UK, US, Europe and Asia-Pacific buying specialty and cyber insurance through Lloyd's and company platforms.
rationale: Global cyber and specialty insurer selling through brokers; F1 hospitality and tech storytelling suit broker relationships, as rivals Aon and Marsh already partner F1.

name: Schroders
desc: British asset and wealth manager, including Schroders Capital, Schroders Wealth Management and Cazenove Capital, now combined with Nuveen.
ownership: subsidiary of Nuveen (owned by TIAA); Schroder family previously held 44%
capacity_detail: Nuveen agreed in Feb 2026 to buy Schroders at 612p per share, valuing it at GBP 9.9bn; completion announced 30 Sept 2026; revenue GBP 3.25bn in 2025
markets: Institutional, intermediary and private wealth clients across Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Americas and the Middle East.
rationale: Global investment brand serving wealthy clients and institutions; parent Nuveen already sponsors Williams, offering an easy route to F1 client hospitality.
